name: Rift-Fed Blades
text: Heroes' ATK grows with all the basic-attack damage the team deals this run.

name: Reliquary Lamp
text: Heroes' basic stats rise for every relic you hold.

name: Gilded Rift
text: Heroes' ATK and MGK rise with the shards you hold.

name: Hollow Crown
text: Each hero gets a fourth loadout slot.

name: Widened Offering
text: The after-fight pick shows one more card.

name: Reliquary
flavor: Small things, kept well, grow heavy.
text: Every common relic you hold counts twice.

name: Warden's Engine
flavor: The wall remembers every blow it turned.
text: Shields heroes give are larger, and Shielded heroes' ATK and MGK rise with their Shield.

passives.name: Warden's Engine
passives.text: Its ATK rises with its Shield.

passives.name: Warden's Engine
passives.text: Its MGK rises with its Shield.

name: Hunter's Engine
flavor: The mark deepens with every look.
text: Marks heroes apply stack, crits hit harder for each Mark on the enemy, and a crit on a Marked enemy Marks the enemies around it.

passives.name: Hunter's Engine
passives.text: Its crits hit harder for each Mark on the enemy.

passives.name: Hunter's Engine
passives.text: A crit on a Marked enemy Marks every enemy within 1 hex of it.

name: Shadow Engine
flavor: What the dark takes, it gives back sharpened.
text: While hidden, heroes' basic attacks hit far harder and steal life, and lifesteal past full HP strikes their target.

passives.name: Shadow Engine
passives.text: While Stealthed, its basic attacks deal more damage.

passives.name: Shadow Engine
passives.text: While Stealthed, its basic attacks steal life.

passives.name: Shadow Engine
passives.text: While Stealthed, lifesteal past full HP hits its target.

name: Quickening
flavor: Every blow comes sooner than the last.
text: Every hit makes the hero attack faster for the rest of the fight, with no cap.

passives.name: Quickening
passives.text: Every hit makes it attack faster for the rest of the fight.

name: Crown of Stars
flavor: Each point of light a wound.
text: Heroes' crits can crit again, many times in a row, each roll a little less likely and a little weaker.

name: Shared Pain
text: Damage heroes deal to an enemy echoes to the other enemies sharing its keyword, weaker each step.

name: The Hungering Rift
text: Damage past an enemy's last HP carries to the nearest enemy, and keeps carrying until it runs out.

name: Overcharge
flavor: The vessel cracks. The light keeps pouring.
text: Heroes' mana keeps filling past a full bar, and each extra bar fires the signature again, stronger each time.

name: Second Dawn
flavor: The rift is not the end. Not yet.
text: The first time each hero falls in a fight, it rises again a little later; if every hero is down at once, the fight is lost.

name: Unending Vigil
flavor: The longer the watch, the sharper the eye.
text: Every second a hero spends near full HP makes them hit harder for the rest of the fight, with no cap.

passives.name: Unending Vigil
passives.text: Every second above 75% HP, it hits harder for the rest of the fight.

name: Iron Garden
flavor: What grows here holds everything still.
text: Every time a hero Roots or Stuns an enemy, every hero hits harder for the rest of the fight, with no cap.

passives.name: Iron Garden
passives.text: Every Root or Stun it puts on an enemy makes every hero hit harder for the rest of the fight.

name: Stillwater Seal
text: Burn on a Rooted or Stunned enemy doesn't fade, and heroes' crits against it hit harder.

passives.name: Stillwater Seal
passives.text: Its crits hit Rooted or Stunned enemies harder.
